quality_rule: Every PLU classification must preserve source text.
Every PLU classification must include a canonical PLU ID.
Every PLU classification must include confidence.
Unknown or unsupported contexts must not be discarded.
Administrative noise must be explicitly excluded.
Evaluation navigation must not be treated as evaluation method.
Pricing structure must not be treated as price evaluation unless award context exists.
Proposal structure must not be treated as evaluation factor unless award context exists.
Discovery queue items must include evidence and reason.
Downstream engines should consume PLU outputs before raw text where possible.
